summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 39% YoY to Rs 380 crore, but EBITDA margin fell to 35% (from 40% in Q4 FY26) on credit provisions and one-time items.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 380 crore (+39% YoY, +Rs 29 crore QoQ), with EBITDA of Rs 139 crore (+30% YoY) at a 35% margin versus 40% in Q4 FY26. Core crane rental EBITDA margin fell to 47% from 53% in FY26; management attributed about 6 points to ECL provisions on aged receivables (~Rs 6.2 crore), FX mark-to-market (Rs 1.4 crore), a one-time employee incentive, and revenue-mix shifts to ancillary equipment and cross-rental. Management reiterated FY27 guidance of Rs 1,400-1,500 crore revenue and Rs 525-575 crore EBITDA, with the bulk of the Rs 652 crore capex pool deploying in H2.

segments.name: Crane rental (India + Botswana)
segments.commentary: Utilisation ~86% at a 2.29% yield; contributes ~60% of revenue from operations. Fleet of 492 cranes, gross block ~Rs 3,300 crore.

segments.name: GCC (Saudi Arabia, Qatar)
segments.commentary: Utilisation ~86% at a 4.10% yield; total income Rs 19 crore at 23% EBITDA margin; Saudi operation cumulatively EBITDA positive. Management cites ~47% EBITDA margin for KSA crane rental. DSO 201 days.

segments.name: Renewable E&C (Sangreen Future Renewable)
segments.commentary: Contributes ~37% of revenue, ahead of full-year mix on execution phasing. Wind E&C EBITDA margin 18% before unallocated costs (10-12% after). Order book ~Rs 680-686 crore.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 1,400-1,500 crore, EBITDA Rs 525-575 crore (unchanged); blended return on capital 16.25-16.5%.
FY27 EBITDA growth of 20-30% on FY26 EBITDA of Rs 429 crore; blended margin expected to be lower.
FY28 guidance: revenue growth 30-40% and EBITDA growth 20-30% (EBITDA Rs 650-700 crore).
Credit provision expected to normalise over FY27 as aged receivables are recovered; management expects ~15% revenue uplift in FY27 from the capex.
Debt-to-equity guided at 0.72x on a gross consolidated basis; management cites treasury surplus of over Rs 300 crore, implying net 0.3-0.7x.
capex_capacity: FY27 capex pool of Rs 652 crore approved by the board; Rs 92 crore capitalised in Q1, balance in H2 FY27.
Of the capex, ~Rs 324 crore is for the Middle East (Rs 316 crore revenue-generating), with orders placed with OEMs; revenue contribution expected between Q3 and Q4 FY27.
Fleet 492 cranes; management declined to disclose incremental lifting capacity.
Cross-rental and ancillary equipment used in Q1 to meet demand without fresh capex (lower margin, no capital consumed).
Plans to add a depot in KSA and/or Qatar; location and timing not disclosed.
demand_pricing: Order book ~Rs 1,250 crore for the group, stated as fully executable within FY27; inquiry pipeline ~Rs 5,600 crore (Rs 4,656 crore for E&C).
Renewable E&C order book ~Rs 686 crore, already above FY26 renewable revenue; management expects ~15% of that book may slip into FY28.
KSA 0-12 month executable inquiry pipeline ~$22 million; zero-to-24-month Middle East pipeline ~$38 million.
Management says yields in India have improved over the last quarter and are not being capped by competition; no material change in client tenure or rate-reset behaviour.
Wind industry: 6 GW added last year, ~29 GW under construction; thermal 62 GW under bid or award.

qa_highlights.question: Where would an incremental crane go, India or KSA, and what drives the decision?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said allocation depends on inquiry pipeline, order visibility and duration, market-share needs and internal IRR hurdle, with group ROCE as the anchor.

qa_highlights.question: Will the blended margin fall as renewables reach one-third of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Sangreen is asset-light with lower margin; blended margin will be lower but absolute EBITDA is up, with FY27 EBITDA guided at Rs 525-575 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Does the 0.72x debt-to-equity imply debt of Rs 1,000-1,100 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called 0.72x a gross consolidated ceiling, said it is comfortable, and noted a treasury surplus of over Rs 300 crore; net D/E estimated at 0.3-0.7x.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ECL provision one-time and is it India-only?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly India, nothing from KSA; management expects normalisation over FY27 as aged debtors are recovered, with a Rs 3-4 crore reversal from Q4 to Q1 cited.

qa_highlights.question: What is the E&C margin outlook, and is 18% wind E&C margin sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: The 18% is before unallocated costs (10-12% after); management guides E&C to settle at 12-15%, with slippage risk from client-side delays and POCM revenue recognition.

qa_highlights.question: Why is GCC DSO 201 days, and when will it fall?
qa_highlights.answer: Attributed to West Asia disruption; management said significant collections occurred in July, with improvement visible in Q2 results, and zero working-capital draw in KSA.

qa_highlights.question: What is the timeline for GCC capex and is supply delayed by West Asia conflict?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said supply chain disruption is temporary, orders are placed with OEMs, and Rs 316 crore of revenue-generating capex should come online between Q3 and Q4 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What are the cost and currency terms of new borrowings?
qa_highlights.answer: India INR debt at around 8% (plus or minus 0.25%); overseas USD debt at SOFR plus 5.5-6%. Blended cost to be disclosed at half-year.

risks_watch: Credit provisions: ECL charge of ~Rs 6.2 crore on aged receivables (mostly India) is expected to normalise over FY27; track whether provisions actually fall and collections recover in Q2.
GCC/KSA working capital: DSO of 201 days with West Asia disruption cited; management says significant July collections and DSO improvement will show in Q2 results, so verify.

Capex execution: Rs 652 crore pool with bulk deploying in H2 FY27; Rs 316 crore Middle East revenue-generating capex expected Q3-Q4 FY27 despite supply-chain disruption; watch OEM delivery and commissioning dates.

Renewable E&C margins and execution: wind E&C margin 18% before unallocated costs (10-12% after); guided to 12-15%; ~15% of Rs 686 crore order book may slip into FY28 on client delays and POCM revenue recognition.

Blended margin dilution as Sangreen grows toward one-third of revenue; FY27 EBITDA guided Rs 525-575 crore, and debt-to-equity of 0.72x gross ceiling (management says net 0.3-0.7x) with cost of debt and blended borrowing cost not disclosed until half-year.
key_quotes: So, overall, we grew the top line and gave back margin and that is the real outcome.
So, Saudi is not a response to India and India is not a response to Saudi Arabia.
So, the ECL provision is expected to normalize in the course of the financial year as we recover debtors which has basically aged.
And we believe that the entirety of this CAPEX should come offline in terms of revenue generation between the third and fourth quarter of this financial year.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-looking on demand, KSA, and the Rs 1,250 crore order book, but candid and somewhat defensive on margin, explaining the 6-point core crane margin drop as ECL, FX, a one-time incentive and mix. Management was evasive on lifting capacity, the blended cost of borrowing, and the specifics of E&C margin sustainability, deflecting several questions.
